title_es: Historia de los profetas y los reyes (Tarij al-Tabari)
title_en: History of the Prophets and Kings (Tarikh al-Tabari)
date: c. 302 AH (c. 915 CE); author d. 310 AH
edition_original: Dar al-Turath, Beirut, 2nd ed. 1387 AH (per Shamela header); 11 vols.; editor not in header
licence: OpenITI corpus text (metadata row in it/oimeta.csv); the modern print edition named here is the source of the Shamela digitisation. Licence of the text and of the print edition NOT verified.
authenticity_note: Genuine text of Tabari; his isnads are printed; "Abu Ja'far" comments are Tabari's own. Not a single-manuscript check.
notes: Read: vol. 2 pp. 398-400 (marriage; Aisha's own words); vol. 3 pp. 161-163 (Khawla, Abu Bakr, Mut'im, six); vol. 3 pp. 425-426 (Abu Bakr's wives and children). Year-73 entry: no age for Asma found by search.

edition_original: ed. Muhammad Abd al-Qadir Ata, Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyya, Beirut, 1st ed. 1410/1990; 8 vols.
licence: OpenITI corpus text (metadata row in it/oimeta.csv); the modern print edition named here is the source of the Shamela digitisation. Licence of the text and of the print edition NOT verified.
authenticity_note: Ibn Sa'd's book; reports cited with full isnads, mostly Waqidi and Hisham chains.
notes: Read: vol. 8 pp. 46-49 (Aisha entry; Hisham-chain variants 6/7/9; Ma'mar-Zuhri 7 or 9; Zuhri-Burqan 6/9/18); p. 63 (birth in 4th year of prophethood; marriage in 10th year at six); p. 201 (Asma: death after Ibn al-Zubayr, 73 AH; no age).

title_es: Libro de las expediciones (Sira de Ibn Ishaq)
date: author d. 151 AH; text as transmitted by Yunus ibn Bukayr (d. 199 AH)
edition_original: ed. Suhayl Zakkar, Dar al-Fikr, Beirut, 1st ed. 1398/1978
licence: OpenITI corpus text (metadata row in it/oimeta.csv); the modern print edition named here is the source of the Shamela digitisation. Licence of the text and of the print edition NOT verified.
authenticity_note: Known only through recensions (Yunus, Salama, Ibn Hisham). The text read is the Yunus recension. Isnads "نا يونس" are the recension's own.
notes: Read: p. 143 (converts list, Aisha "young"); p. 255 (marriage: 6, 9, 18 via Yunus-Hisham-Urwa). Earliest explicit age statement I found in a read text.

date: recension of Ibn Ishaq; Ibn Hisham d. 213 AH (header)
edition_original: ed. Mustafa al-Saqqa, Ibrahim al-Abyari, Abd al-Hafiz al-Shalabi, 2nd ed. 1375/1955 (Mustafa al-Babi al-Halabi)
licence: OpenITI corpus text (metadata row in it/oimeta.csv); the modern print edition named here is the source of the Shamela digitisation. Licence of the text and of the print edition NOT verified.
authenticity_note: Ibn Hisham's recension of Ibn Ishaq plus his own notes. The unattributed sentence in vol. 2 p. 644 has no isnad.
notes: Read: vol. 1 p. 252 (converts: Aisha "then young"); vol. 2 p. 644 (7 at contract; 9 or 10 at consummation).

title_es: El Mustadrak sobre los dos Sahihs
date: author d. 405 AH (per general knowledge; not read in my texts)
edition_original: ed. Mustafa Abd al-Qadir Ata, Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyya, 1st ed. 1411/1990; 4 vols.
licence: OpenITI corpus text (metadata row in it/oimeta.csv); the modern print edition named here is the source of the Shamela digitisation. Licence of the text and of the print edition NOT verified.
authenticity_note: Hakim's grading ("sahih on Muslim's condition") is his own; Dhahabi's epitome notes appear in the text.
notes: Read: hadith around no. 2704 (7 at marriage, same chain as Tabari vol. 3 p. 162). Volume and page not resolved from the text (no page markers).

title_es: Biografías de los nobles (Siyar a'lam al-nubala')
edition_original: ed. Shu'ayb al-Arna'ut et al., Mu'assasat al-Risala, 3rd ed. 1405/1985
licence: OpenITI corpus text (metadata row in it/oimeta.csv); the modern print edition named here is the source of the Shamela digitisation. Licence of the text and of the print edition NOT verified.
authenticity_note: Dhahabi's own judgments and quotations. Page markers in the OpenITI copy are placeholders (PageV00P000) for the relevant sections; pages not resolved.
notes: Read: Hisham ibn Urwa entry vol. 6 pp. 34-35 (Ya'qub ibn Shayba, Ibn Khirash, Dhahabi's defence); Asma entry vol. 3 pp. 379-380 (Ibn Abi al-Zinad: ten years older; Dhahabi's 91); Aisha section (Hisham versions; Bukhari "mursal" remark).
